title: Screen Khud Ghoom Gayi… Par Kaise? 🤯 #shorts
title_en: Why Your Phone Screen Rotates by Itself 🤯 #shorts
description:
Bistar par lete… aur phone ki screen khud ghoom gayi! Phone ki to aankhen nahi — phir use pata kaise chala?
Raaz: chawal ke daane se bhi chhoti ek chip, jis mein springs par latka ek nanha sa wazan hai. Zameen use neeche kheenchti hai… aur phone samajh jata hai ke neeche kis taraf hai!

Your phone has a chip smaller than a grain of rice (an accelerometer) with a microscopic weight on springs. Gravity pulls it, so the phone knows which way is down — that's why the screen flips when you lie on your side.

آپ کا فون آپ کو نہیں، زمین کو دیکھتا ہے!

description_en:
Ever lain down in bed and watched your phone screen rotate by itself? Your phone has no eyes — it has a chip smaller than a grain of rice (an accelerometer) with a microscopic weight on tiny springs. Gravity pulls the weight, it shifts less than the width of a hair, and the chip knows which way is down. That's why the screen flips when you lie on your side: it follows the Earth, not you.
